system.description:
Also at 3rd level, you begin to build your repertoire of destruction. Wrathbearers gain shapes which can be applied to ranged and melee damaging cantrips to increase their destructive capabilities. By spending 1 exertion, you can apply a shape that you know. Cantrips with secondary effects apply the effect to any creature or object that fails its saving throw. Shaped cantrips cannot be @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-class-features.Item.InY4G6aI2RiNKVgM]{Splitcast}.

Choose two of the following shapes.

Blast (Ranged Cantrips)

This shape strikes all creatures and objects in a 5ft radius within the cantrip’s range. Creatures in the area that make a successful Dexterity save against your spell save DC take half damage.

Burst (Melee Cantrips)

This shape strikes all creatures and objects adjacent to you and pushes them 5ft away. On a successful Strength save against your spell save DC, a creature takes half damage and is not pushed away.

Cloud (Ranged Cantrips)

This shape creates a 10ft radius cloud within the cantrip’s range until the end of your next turn. Creatures that enter the cloud or end their turn within it take damage. On a successful Constitution save against your spell save DC, they take half damage.

Cone (Melee or Ranged Cantrips)

This shape strikes all creatures and objects in a 15ft long cone originating from you. Creatures that make a successful Dexterity save against your spell save DC take half damage.

Line (Melee Cantrips)

This shape strikes all creatures in a 5ft wide 25ft long line originating from you. Creatures that make a successful Dexterity save against your spell save DC take half damage.

Wall (Ranged Cantrips)

This shape creates three 5ft unoccupied squares that must form a connected line within the cantrip’s range until the end of your next turn. A creature that begins or ends their turn adjacent to the wall, or who passes through the wall on their turn, takes damage. A creature that makes a successful Wisdom save against your spell save DC takes half damage.
